observations: Crankcase centre is already near the reference wheelbase-relative location; do not shift the whole engine.
The upper engine height is retained after an inspection preview; carburettor is too high and too far aft.
The front tip of the lateral cover overlaps much more of the rear tank on the official profiles.
The visible opening below the carburettor should be a narrow mechanical clearance, not a large triangular void.
Flexible intake, fuel line and throttle cable must follow the carburettor, while tank/head/handlebar endpoints stay fixed.
uncertainty: Manual photographic comparison; estimated fitting corrections, not OEM measurements. Perspective and limited source resolution prevent millimetric calibration.
